title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides interest subsidy and financial grants up to Rs. 2.67 Lakhs for construction of houses to urban families belonging to EWS, LIG, and MIG categories.
eligibility_text: Urban families below age 70 years with annual household income up to 3.0 lakh.
benefits_text: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans with maximum subsidy value of Rs. 2,67,000 directly credited to loan accounts.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for PMAY-U?
faqs.answer: Any urban family with income below 3 lakh not owning any other brick house in India.

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Scheme
description: An initiative by the Government of India that provides Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all small and marginal landholding farmer families.
eligibility_text: Small and marginal farmers above 18 years owning cultivable land up to 5 acres.
benefits_text: Direct cash transfer of Rs. 6,000 annually split into three equal quarterly bank transfers of Rs. 2,000.

faqs.question: Is land ownership required for PM-KISAN?
faqs.answer: Yes, valid land cultivation registry certificates are required to be submitted.

title: TN Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Thittam
description: Monthly cash assistance scheme for eligible women heads of households in Tamil Nadu to improve economic livelihood and financial independence.
eligibility_text: Women above 21 years with annual household income below 2.5 lakh and electricity consumption under 3600 units.
benefits_text: Direct monthly bank account transfer of Rs. 1,000 on the 15th of every month.

faqs.question: Can multiple women in a family apply?
faqs.answer: No, only one eligible female head per family Ration Card can receive the benefit.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Insurance
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The largest health assurance scheme in the world, providing a health cover of Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility_text: Low income families below annual household income of 2.5 lakh listed in SECC registry.
benefits_text: Cashless hospitalization cover of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year in all government and empaneled private hospitals.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing diseases covered?
faqs.answer: Yes, all pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one of card activation.

title: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Higher Education Girl Grant)
title_ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் புதுமைப் பெண் திட்டம்
description: TN higher education assurance scheme providing financial assistance to girl students who studied in government schools to pursue collegiate education.
eligibility_text: Girl students above 17 years and below 25 years who studied classes 6th to 12th in Tamil Nadu government schools.
benefits_text: Monthly deposit of Rs. 1,000 directly into the student's bank account till completion of college degree or diploma.

faqs.question: Is postgraduate education covered under this?
faqs.answer: The benefit is offered for undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI course completion only.
